notes: Build capture of the delayed check (#441 Today, #442 Canvas), compared in fidelity mode with the approved TARGET surface learn-delayed-check. Each case mounts the shipped components on an E2E-only fixture route: TodaySession with its check rows for the Today frames, and CanvasCheck for the Canvas frames. A local client answers their reads and commands with server-shaped projections parsed by the shared schemas, and the harness scripts interactive states through the real controls. Approved states: On Today (today-locked), Canvas entry (entry), Check open (open), Answer not accepted (rejected), Back after a refresh (restored), Couldn’t submit (save-failed, offline), Saved, waiting for a result (pending and today-saved), Scoring didn’t finish (scoring-failed), Result can’t be confirmed (unconfirmed and today-unconfirmed), Check can’t count (invalid), Passed (passed and today-result-ready), Not yet (not-yet), No check ready (unavailable). States approved as built after the mockup: the refused start (entry-refused), the help limit (help-limit), an accepted practice answer (practice-submitted), feedback publishing (publishing) and the closed Today row (today-closed). Omitted: the Today page’s calendar card and the Void route shell around the Canvas check (its thread header, and the Open your Void link under the check); CanvasCheck renders its own header. Synthetic copy only, with no learner data, answer keys, rubrics, criteria or scores shown.
